about.paragraph1: On the slopes of Mount Kozjak, in Kaštela, a small agricultural town between Split and Trogir, high-quality and premium wines are produced.
about.paragraph2: The Kuzmanić family has been producing white and red wines in a traditional way for several generations. Their vineyard is located near the Biblical Garden – the ancient shrine of Our Lady of Stomorija in Kaštel Novi, offering a breathtaking view of the Kaštela Bay.
about.paragraph3: The entire process, from cultivating and maintaining the vineyard to harvesting and crushing the grapes, is done by hand, involving all family members. After a year of dedicated work and effort, they produce four types of wine, all of which are indigenous to central Dalmatia.
about.last.section.paragraph1: A small boutique winery is part of the family home, which also offers accommodation services, and is located near the beach and Split Airport.
about.last.section.paragraph2: The vineyard and winery are ideal for hosting small groups of visitors for tastings of their multiple award-winning wines. Their selection includes red wines – Crljenak Kaštelanski, Plavac Mali, and Babica – as well as a white wine, Tribljan.
